admission.justification: A future cleanup optimization must not infer absence or recovery from an unread kind, failed ref listing or missing checkout. The two destructive owners and complete/partial/click-race/branch-without-checkout assertions guard against lost live acknowledgements and deleted current snapshots.

applicability: Reconciliation of supported current acknowledgement rows for every published kind - the three live native causes through their own end observations, and the operational and notice sources - and pruning of valid drift snapshots whose native repository or branch subject is demonstrably gone.
conditions: Removal needs an actual complete successful observation of the corresponding kind; missing, failed or incomplete kind reads cannot prove recovery or absence.

A live occurrence ends only on its own observation: an answered prompt, a delivered or withdrawn held message, or a bound turn that closes a stall interval; a stall's live set is the interval rather than the published row, so a reader that restarted before the deadline reclaims nothing.
An acknowledgement newer than the observation read start is retained; valid UTC-aware source observations provide the comparison.
Branch existence comes from a successful native branch census and complete contract/directory inputs, not absence of a snapshot or checkout; usable snapshot identities are required.
exclusions: Tolerant cleanup of malformed/unsupported retired-kind log lines; these are not live supported acknowledgement rows.
Treating stale retained projection slots, a missing snapshot, an absent checkout or a failed git/ref/directory read as proof that a live subject ended.

evidence: M1-21: ROW-TBM8W7; mcp/src/agents_remember/serving/projections/snapshots_impl/_common.py:197-221. Static source witness on A013; no Curator execution.

statement: Dismissal cleanup reclaims only things or ended occurrences proved gone by a complete successful source observation.
